run_analyze_results_cli: run the analyze_results CLI to evaluate and visualize object detection results from a pkl file
test_bbox_map_eval: test the bbox_map_eval function to compute per-image mAP from detection results and ground truth annotations
build_result_visualizer: build a ResultVisualizer instance to display and save evaluation results with ground truth and predictions
review_detection_evaluate: review the ResultVisualizer.detection_evaluate method to rank images by per-image mAP and select topk good and bad samples
summarize_panoptic_evaluate: summarize the ResultVisualizer.panoptic_evaluate method to rank panoptic segmentation samples by PQ score
